title: Visualize sampled world roads
changes: Overlay uniquely linked sampled roads on the world-node plot using signed pixel offsets from the lower-index node; select a road or node link to inspect and animate its samples.
Preserve the recorded final point without extending a road to its neighboring node.
validation: Synthetic Linux Chrome unit rom-data-viewer-roads-io3__c78 checked lower-node geometry, a short endpoint, reverse node links, sample selection and preview animation.
Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-roads-eur-h9_e9pfp compared all 45 road sample arrays and node pairs, then checked a short endpoint and marker in Chrome.
limitations: The animation uses a fixed preview rate of ten samples per second, not game timing. Ambiguous or unavailable links are omitted from the overlay.
